description: Shared Renovate preset for every Assorted mod. A mod's renovate.json extends github>grim3212/AssortedBuild//renovate/default and nothing else.

packageRules.description: The build itself: plugin and catalog move together, and a bump is the whole point of Renovate here.
assortedlib_version is a mod's declared minimum, not a version to chase. Bumped by hand when the mod needs something newer.
Minecraft, NeoForge, Fabric, JEI: these live in AssortedBuild's catalog, so a mod never gets a PR for them.
